errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the horizontal axis contains the categories. The horizontal axis represents the percentages, while the vertical axis lists the categories.
The chart label is “Работните срещи” (Work meetings), not “Работни среди” (Working environments).
The categories are not ordered alphabetically. They are ordered by their corresponding percentage value in ascending order from top to bottom.
The description incorrectly states that the vertical axis represents the percentages. The vertical axis lists the categories, while the horizontal axis shows the percentages.
